steps.title: Pull spot
steps.rule: Stack at the south edge before Titan lands: Geocrush hurts less the farther you are.

steps.title: Tank south, party north
steps.rule: Party stacks just north of Titan; the main tank takes him south.

MainTank.rule: Hold Titan south of centre, facing away from the party.

steps.title: Swap sides for the Weights
steps.rule: Party swings to Titan's east side; the main tank goes west.

MainTank.rule: Move to the west side for the Weight of the Land.

steps.title: Back to tank south, party north
steps.rule: Return: party north, main tank south.
steps.cue: First Weight of the Land resolves

steps.title: Run opposite the jump
steps.rule: Everyone runs to the edge straight across from where Titan is facing.
steps.cue: Titan turns to face his jump

steps.title: Hug the far edge for Geocrush
steps.rule: Tight stack on the edge across from the landing.

steps.title: Hold the edge for Upheaval
steps.rule: Stay stacked on the edge and face the centre, so the knockback slides you along the wall.

steps.title: Bait the Landslide through the middle
steps.rule: Without a marker, stand across the arena so the Landslide line runs between the gaol spots.

steps.title: Jailed: beside your gaol spot
steps.rule: With a gaol marker, stand beside your gaol spot, out of the Landslide line.

steps.title: Main tank west, safe side
steps.rule: Main tank holds the west edge on the side the Landslide won't cross.

steps.title: Party north of centre
steps.rule: Party stacks north of centre, out of the Landslide.

steps.title: Jailed: sprint into the chain
steps.rule: With a gaol marker, sprint onto your spot in the chain line.

steps.title: Party to the north-east
steps.rule: Party moves north-east, between the gaols and the bombs.

steps.title: Main tank holds west
steps.rule: Main tank stays on the west edge.

steps.title: Main tank to the safe diagonal
steps.rule: Main tank steps to the west diagonal on the safe side.

steps.title: Main tank crosses to the east
steps.rule: Main tank runs to the east edge, Titan's far side.

steps.title: Party on Titan's left for Tumult
steps.rule: Party stacks on Titan's left side for the Tumults.

steps.title: Main tank steps in
steps.rule: Main tank moves in closer to Titan.

steps.title: Main tank to the centre
steps.rule: Main tank moves to the centre for the Weights.

steps.title: Party swaps to Titan's right
steps.rule: Party crosses to Titan's right side.

steps.title: Main tank back out west
steps.rule: Main tank steps back out to the west.

steps.title: Party sidesteps the puddles
steps.rule: Party steps aside, out of the Weight puddles.

steps.title: Follow the group through the awakened Landslides
steps.rule: Keep moving with the party: out of each Landslide line, then back together.

steps.title: Stack west for the second jump
steps.rule: Stack on the west side, across from the landing.

steps.title: Stay west as the floor shrinks
steps.rule: Stay stacked west, inside the smaller arena.

steps.title: Party in front, jailed healer behind
steps.rule: Party in front of Titan; the marked healer behind him; main tank on the far side.

steps.title: Hold: party in front, healer behind
steps.rule: Keep the same shape: party in front of Titan, marked healer behind.

steps.title: Off tank takes the Mountain Buster
steps.rule: Off tank behind Titan for the buster; main tank in front.

OffTank.rule: Step behind Titan to take the Mountain Buster.

steps.title: Party behind Titan, ranged in front
steps.rule: Party stacks behind Titan (east); the regen healer and the caster stay in front.

steps.title: Main tank to Titan's side
steps.rule: Main tank steps to Titan's side for the Rock Buster.

steps.title: Stack centre for the transition
steps.rule: Tight stack in the centre.
